dedupe_keys.name: coudlabs wp8 t811 uos 001 investigating geometrical effects on hydraulic energy losses during sewer to surface flow interactions during urban floods

description: Brazier, Kaeli at University of Sheffield publishes pressure, flow-rate and water-depth observations from sewer surcharge experiments through Co-UDlabs. A physical scale model studies hydraulic exchange from a pipe through a manhole into surface flooding. Different lid properties and flow rates quantify effects on exchange and pressure; the deposit includes raw data and a combination workbook. Coverage is the University of Sheffield experimental system; exact scale, experiment dates and measurement frequencies are not stated. Zenodo provides raw-data ZIP, XLSX combination workbook and PDF report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the source does not enumerate every lid geometry or provide transferable loss coefficients in its metadata. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
